**15.09.78 New York City, NY, intro**##030390|Intro to ‘Something "Something in the Night’:**Night"##**
”How many of you guys were at the Garden ? (cheers)....here’s something we didn’t play then.....’Something in the Night’....”

**15.09.78 New York City, NY, intro**##030390|Intro to ‘Spirit "Spirit in the Night’:**Night"##**
”Where’d you get this ?....off the street ?....now I got my accoutrements (chuckles)...”

**15.09.78 New York City, NY, intro**##030390|Intro to ‘The "The Promised Land’:**Land"##**
(someone screams ”Kitty’s Back !”)....Kitty’s back.....(?)....I promise I’ll play it for you in the second set, alright ? (cheers)....I promise to do that song.....(chuckles) .... we haven’t played that song in about three years (chuckles)....(?)....a promise is a promise, alright (chuckles).....”

**15.09.78 New York City, NY, intro**##030390|Intro to ‘Sandy’:** "Sandy"##**
”I’ll be right back ......(long pause)....here’s a summer song for you.....everybody’s back in school now.....uuuh (chuckles)..

**15.09.78 New York City, NY, middle**##030390|Middle of ´Backstreets´** "Backstreets"##**
´´Hey....hey little girl....little girl....baby, it´s good.....baby, it´s good to see you back again..... and you´re still looking fine.....baby, it´s been such a long and lonely time.....such a long, long time.....little darling, I remember you....little girl, I remember you....and I know you remember me too....you were standing on the corner....of Richmond Avenue....and I swore I´d drive all night long....I swore I´d drive all night long....little girl, I´d drive all night long.... little girl, I´d drive all night long....just to buy you some shoes....or to taste your tender charms....to have you hold me in your arms.....and for just one kiss and a look from your sad eyes.....a look from your sad eyes.....just one look from your sad eyes.....all the time, you was crying, crying, crying.....baby, you was crying, crying, crying.....little girl, cry, cry, crying.....little girl was cry, cry, crying and me, I was your fool.....baby, I was just your fool ....´cause I thought, baby, I could stop, stop some of your crying, maybe I could stop, stop some of your crying, maybe I could stop, stop some of your crying but little girl, you were lying.....baby, you´d been lying....baby, you were lying....little girl, you were lying....you were so young and you could tell such pretty lies....you were so young and you could tell such pretty lies.....you were so young and you could tell such pretty lies.....you were so young and you could tell such pretty lies.....and now you´re back.....well, baby I´m back too .....and I´ve been out.....and I´ve seen some things.....about me.....and about you.....and it´s time, girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we stopped, little girl, it´s time we STOPPED.....´´
